request.text: Starting Monday, September 7, 2026, remind me every weekday at 7:15 PM to review the notes for tomorrow's seminar.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a recurring weekday reminder beginning September 7, 2026 at 7:15 PM to review the next day's seminar notes.

new_goals.description: Schedule a recurring weekday reminder to review the next day's seminar notes.
new_goals.source_text: Starting Monday, September 7, 2026, remind me every weekday at 7:15 PM to review the notes for tomorrow's seminar.
constraints: Begin the recurrence on Monday, September 7, 2026.
Use reviewing the notes for tomorrow's seminar as the reminder content.
success_criteria: A weekday recurrence beginning on the requested date is scheduled at 7:15 PM with the requested study content.

semantic_facts: The Planner should prepare recurring reminder Work and confirmation wording that preserves the September 7 start date, weekday recurrence, 7:15 PM time, and seminar-note content.
No occurrence may be installed until the user confirms the complete recurring schedule.
forbidden_claims: The recurring reminder or any of its occurrences already exists.
The user has confirmed the proposed recurring schedule.
The seminar notes have been reviewed.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A recurring request is partially executed while only a summary or first occurrence is presented for confirmation.
The confirmation loses a material recurrence boundary such as its start date or weekday cadence.
